drafts.text:
alex says his agent now does 100% of the work he doesn't want to do.

for a 20-room amsterdam boutique hotel, that's the 11pm guest email, the review reply, the late check-in question.

not another tool. the hire you never made: a company brain that knows your house.
keywords: work I don't want to do
drafts.rides: AlexFinn 'it's the best AI agent ever. Dead simple and just works. Has automated basically 100% of work I don't want to do' (98.7K, 1,112 bookmarks)

drafts.text:
greg says a company is a loop: get context, run agents on it, feed the data back.

an amsterdam boutique hotel already sits on that context: years of guest questions and public reviews.

we turn it into a company brain and ship a free sample built from public reviews.
drafts.rides: gregisenberg 'building a company these days is basically a loop: acquire valuable context, orchestrate agents...' (98.2K, 1,149 bookmarks), plus his 'state of startups in 1 chart' (26.6K)

drafts.text:
greg: the cracked marketer is now more in demand than the cracked engineer.

amsterdam boutique hotels feel this. the margin lost to commissions is recoverable, but nobody on a small team has hours to market direct.

that's the missing headcount AI can fill.

video_tip: Video tip: 20–30s vertical screen recording. Open on Alex's line 'automated basically 100% of work I don't want to do' (98.7K), then show a real-looking guest question landing late at night and the hotel's company brain answering from its own house info. End on 'the hire you never made'. Show it working, no numbers you can't back.
